g.title: UniverseBuilding
g.text: How the candidate universe is being built

g.title: legend
g.text: Arrows show what each achievement makes possible
Green = demonstrated | gold = working example | red = limit found | gray = next frontier

a.xlink:title: DEMONSTRATED Consistent spacetime rules the gravity equations and their built-in redundancies fit together exactly Next: test the same rules on more backgrounds and boundaries
a.text: Next: test the same rules on

a.xlink:title: DEMONSTRATED Cause comes before effect signals propagate forward in time in the starting universe, a clock universe, and the first controlled change of a second curved universe Next: turn the first-order curved change into a full family and add physical boundaries

DEMONSTRATED Equivalent descriptions counted once coordinate and scale choices are removed without losing the surviving information Next: repeat the reduction after boundaries and quantum effects are added

DEMONSTRATED A clock inside the universe healthy matter records change while the total time shift remains redundant in the tested sector Next: test broader clocks and fully backreacted measuring devices

WORKING EXAMPLE Can a repaired universe keep its clock? a changed gravity-clock theory propagates causally, but making time redundant removes its clock; keeping the clock makes time charged, with positive action-angle motion and a rate-dependent phase drift Next: test the pairing, gradients and characteristic behavior of every nonhomogeneous wave sector, then instantiate a nonzero relational receiver
WORKING EXAMPLE Familiar and extra gravity waves both kinds are identified, but the attempted local separation has an exact obstruction Next: find a larger or differently organized description

DEMONSTRATED Ordinary relativity inside the model a complete linear dictionary separates Einstein-like solutions from their extra companions, while also exposing a mismatch in their standard physical pairings Next: extend the dictionary to interactions and decide which sector remains closed
WORKING EXAMPLE Light signals electromagnetic signals propagate causally from localized sources Next: control the complete infinite set of spatial wave patterns

WORKING EXAMPLE Gravitational waves familiar and extra waves both carry currents; extra waves reach a Schwarzschild horizon, but finite symplectic size at infinity selects the familiar sector in both parities at one exact fixture Next: generalize the infinity test in frequency and angular momentum, then build the scattering phase space and detectors
NEXT FRONTIER The other forces and matter electromagnetism is present; strong, weak and chiral matter sectors are not Next: add strong-force, weak- force and fermion fields
DEMONSTRATED Black holes at rest a static family has regular horizons, energy, entropy and an exact first law Next: construct a time- dependent horizon phase space and connect it to the wave sector

DEMONSTRATED Gravity and light interact the first nonlinear laws close exactly for the clock universe and for Einstein gravity coupled to light through third order Next: build the matching fourth -order-gravity interaction package and compare the two branches
limits influence to the causal future

DEMONSTRATED Local emitters and detectors two dynamical sources create two distinct persistent records; the first retarded emitter channel and a finite mass-uniform leading response are exact Next: complete every spatial wave, nonlinear feedback and detector recoil
DEMONSTRATED Quantum observables causal commutators for free curvature measurements are defined exactly Next: construct a physical quantum state and prove positivity

WORKING EXAMPLE Black holes with waves additional axial and polar waves are regular at the horizon, but at one exact frequency their reconstructed fields have infinite symplectic size at infinity, leaving only the Einstein-like waves in the finite-size class Next: prove the boundary classification for symbolic frequency and general angular momentum, then build exterior evolution, ringdown and stability

WORKING EXAMPLE Clocks measure redshift an exact retarded example gives 1+z=2; the finite leading two-channel response stays independent throughout a tested clock-mass range Next: complete the all-wave response, one local frequency comparison, recoil and backreaction
NEXT FRONTIER Where particle masses come from massive apparatus fields can be used, but the universe does not generate its own mass scale Next: build a stable mechanism that creates physical masses
may supply a future charged-time reading
WORKING EXAMPLE Can interactions switch wave types? the interaction can be removed at the first tested derivative levels Next: complete the decisive next-order calculation

WORKING EXAMPLE Which waves survive nonlinear consistency? every finite combination in the complete compact wave catalog continues smoothly exactly when five balances vanish; the global-motion bounded subproblem is solved and two growing directions are universally excluded Next: finish the oscillator and shell-resonance bounded cone, add infinite-wave inputs, and construct causal continuation

WORKING EXAMPLE Do quantum effects break the rules? the strict theory has a one- loop obstruction and a compensator repair; the ghost determinant has an exact spherical benchmark, generic local defect and all eleven integrated third- curvature functions Next: assemble the full ghost and physical metric determinants, then build the Lorentzian quantum theory
a.text: the strict theory has a one-

a.xlink:title: NEXT FRONTIER Quantum particles and scattering a free observable algebra exists, but no physical particle state or scattering theory Next: add a quantum state, positivity and interactions
tests whether ordinary gravity stays closed
NEXT FRONTIER Gravitational lensing no complete local light- bending observable has been built yet Next: trace localized light through dynamical curvature
NEXT FRONTIER Galaxies and cosmic expansion no stable observational cosmology or dark sector has been built yet Next: build expanding solutions, lensing and matter phenomenology
WORKING EXAMPLE A physical quantum vacuum the required short-distance form is known locally, but no global state exists Next: construct a global state compatible with all gauge rules
provides the algebra that needs a state
NEXT FRONTIER One theory for the matter forces no unified group or matter family has been selected Next: unify strong, weak and electromagnetic matter consistently
